Description: sync.thingelstad.xyz: the publishing bus, the scheduled and event-driven sync page, and signed webhook intake

CodeKey.Description: S3 key of the packaged probe in the code bucket; empty on the first apply, which creates the buckets and roles only

CodeVersion.Description: Optional S3 object version of the packaged probe

CertificateArn.Description: ACM certificate for sync.thingelstad.xyz in us-east-1; empty serves the CloudFront domain only

PublisherUser.Description: IAM user WT Builder signs its AWS calls with; it may put events on the publishing bus. Empty grants nobody.

RuntimeSecret.Description: Name of sync-runtime. Reader keys: pinboard_token, microblog_api_key. Webhook signing keys buttondown_webhook_signing_key, github_webhook_signing_key, strava_webhook_signing_key, and strava_webhook_verify_token resolve only when their sender flag is true.

EnableButtondown.Description: Enable the signed Buttondown subscriber webhook only after its sync-runtime signing key exists and the provider is configured.

EnableGitHub.Description: Enable signed GitHub push intake only after its sync-runtime key exists and webhooks for registered public source repositories are configured.

EnableStrava.Description: Enable Strava only after confirming its signing contract, adding both runtime keys and setting the one permitted athlete id.

StravaOwnerId.Description: Non-secret public Strava athlete id permitted for activity events. Empty refuses every Strava request.

WeeklyReceiverRole.Description: Existing weekly sender role name, not ARN. Empty attaches no permission. The policy allows only this source and received/ping on this stack's bus.

AnotherReceiverRole.Description: Existing another sender role name, not ARN. Empty attaches no permission. The policy allows only this source and received/ping on this stack's bus.

LibrarianReceiverRole.Description: Existing librarian sender role name, not ARN. Empty attaches no permission. The policy allows only this source and received/ping on this stack's bus.

ThingyReceiverRole.Description: Existing thingy sender role name, not ARN. Empty attaches no permission. The policy allows only this source and received/ping on this stack's bus.

LinksReceiverRole.Description: Existing links sender role name, not ARN. Empty attaches no permission. The policy allows only this source and received/ping on this stack's bus.

ConfigureLibrarianSubscriber.Description: Create librarian's connection and ping-only rehearsal rule after its runtime token and destination workflow exist.

EnableLibrarianSubscriber.Description: Enable real librarian work only after rehearsal and operator approval.

ConfigureLinksSubscriber.Description: Create links's connection and ping-only rehearsal rule after its runtime token and destination workflow exist.

EnableLinksSubscriber.Description: Enable real links work only after rehearsal and operator approval.

ConfigureRegistrySubscriber.Description: Create registry's connection and ping-only rehearsal rule after its runtime token and destination workflow exist.

EnableRegistrySubscriber.Description: Enable real registry work only after rehearsal and operator approval.

ApproveLinksJoinRepair.Description: Explicit Jamie approval to repair the WT354 join example. Keep false until that decision.
